title: 2008 AMC 10B Problem 18
statement: Bricklayer Brenda would take \(9\) hours to build a chimney alone, and bricklayer Brandon would take \(10\) hours to build it alone. When they work together, they talk a lot, and their combined output is decreased by \(10\) bricks per hour. Working together, they build the chimney in \(5\) hours. How many bricks are in the chimney?

solutions.text:
Let \(n\) be the number of bricks. Brenda lays \(\tfrac{n}{9}\) per hour and Brandon \(\tfrac{n}{10},\) so together they lay \(\tfrac{n}{9}+\tfrac{n}{10}-10\) per hour.

Over \(5\) hours this equals \(n:\) \[5\left(\tfrac{n}{9}+\tfrac{n}{10}-10\right)=n.\] Solving, \(\tfrac{5n}{9}+\tfrac{n}{2}-50=n,\) which gives \(n=900.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Let \(n\) be the number of bricks; their solo rates are \(\tfrac{n}{9}\) and \(\tfrac{n}{10}\)
Together they lay \(\tfrac{n}{9}+\tfrac{n}{10}-10\) bricks per hour for \(5\) hours to total \(n\)
